# ataila_services (Data Source)

The service catalogue: every service a customer can be entitled to (`ataila_service_entitlement`), in display order. Needs a token holding `entitlements-read-global` (or the admin key; a tenant-scoped token may read it too) and platform release 1.0.392 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_services" "all" {}

# The services that need an operator's approval before they are in force.
output "needs_approval" {
  value = [for s in data.ataila_services.all.services : s.key if s.requires_approval]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_inactive` (Boolean) Also list retired services (`active` false).

### Read-Only

- `services` (Attributes List) The services, by `sort_order`, then `key`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) The service is offered. A retired service keeps its entitlements and grants, and none of them is in force.
- `category` (String) `shared` (one instance serves every customer) or `dedicated` (each customer gets its own instance, at its entitlement's `dedicated_url`). Other values may appear.
- `description` (String) What the service is, for a person.
- `enforcement` (String) How the platform makes a grant real: `claim` (checked when the person signs in), `role` (an application role), `projection` (a membership written into the service itself, removed again when the grant is revoked), `manual` (an operator applies it) or `network` (network access). Other values may appear.
- `key` (String) The service's key: lowercase letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter. Entitlements and grants name the service by it.
- `name` (String) The service's display name.
- `requires_approval` (Boolean) Enabling the service for a customer needs an operator's approval in the portal. Until it is approved the entitlement is `pending_approval`, and the API never approves it.
- `sort_order` (Number) Display order, ascending.
- `url` (String) Where the service is used: the shared instance, or for a `dedicated` service the reference instance.
